environment.description: Service runs on ECS Fargate tasks in private subnets (10.0.128.0/20, 10.0.144.0/20) with no NAT gateway egress path configured for inbound initiation. Access is exclusively through a VPC Interface Endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0f4a8b2c1d3e5f6a7) with a VPC Endpoint Policy that restricts the aws:PrincipalOrgID condition to the organization's OU. The endpoint's security group (sg-0abc123def456789a) only permits ingress from CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 on port 8080. There is no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no VPC peering connection to any VPC with public internet access. Route tables for the private subnets contain only local routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and the VPC endpoint prefix list route. DNS resolution for the service hostname resolves to the VPC endpoint ENI private IPs only within the VPC.

config.network: private subnets only, no IGW, no NAT, no peering to public VPCs
config.dns_resolution: private hosted zone, resolves to vpce ENI IPs
